issues.description: Radar chart with 6 dimensions (Warmth, Complexity, Organic, Layered, Heritage, Character) is missing from the visible area — the 'Fingerprint Map' section appears to be below the fold but the chart itself may not be rendering due to hydration errors
issues.root_cause: Multiple hydration errors ('Text content does not match server-rendered HTML') are causing the entire root to switch to client rendering, which likely prevents the chart component (likely using a client-side library like recharts/d3) from rendering correctly. The server-rendered HTML doesn't match client output, possibly due to dynamic data or Math.random() calls in the chart component.

issues.description: Tweak input field is completely missing from the screen
issues.root_cause: The tweak/refinement input field expected per spec is not present in the rendered output. Either it was not implemented in apps/web/app/design/step-4/page.tsx or it is conditionally rendered and the condition evaluates to false.

issues.description: Hydration errors causing server/client HTML mismatch - 7 hydration errors logged, entire root switching to client rendering
issues.root_cause: Dynamic values (likely Date.now(), Math.random(), or non-deterministic data) are being used during server render that differ from client render in apps/web/app/design/step-4/page.tsx or its child components. This causes React to bail out of SSR hydration.
